frameworks.name: UMASC
frameworks.description: A proposed framework for organising cross-disciplinary relationships among awareness, meaning, systems and inquiry.
frameworks.notes: Conceptual proposal; no scientific validation is asserted.

frameworks.name: METAD
frameworks.description: A conceptual proposal for pattern description, symbolic framing and exploratory interpretation.
frameworks.notes: Conceptual proposal; no scientific validation is asserted.

frameworks.name: ACTC
frameworks.description: A conceptual proposal concerning agency, cognition, transformation and explanatory structure.
frameworks.notes: Conceptual proposal; no scientific validation is asserted.

frameworks.name: N2N Signal & Synthesis
frameworks.description: A provenance-aware workflow that turns community archive records into reviewable signals and candidate research questions.
frameworks.notes: Community signals support hypothesis generation and are not scientific evidence by themselves.

frameworks.name: HOMESENSE
frameworks.description: A lived-environment application framework for context-aware human design and practice.
frameworks.notes: Candidate applications require testing; the framework is not validated scientific theory by default.

frameworks.name: AkashicNET
frameworks.description: A provenance-first knowledge network for an auditable living commons spanning research, archives and community knowledge.

versions.notes: Version and snapshot date documented in the repository overview.

frameworks.notes: Confidence describes the documented existence and purpose of the project, not the truth of every concept catalogued by it.
